b:
Into the flood of time
I let a boat
of imagination float

It
drifted,
moved on,
and with nowhere else to go
entered a place

It was a time when even
the boats of time had run aground

Half the crowd of humans
had become prey to nature's hunger;
of the rest, a great many
had moved to other planets

What remained, what was eaten,
were leftovers

The forests did not burn;
they disappeared.
The borders of nations
have still not moved

When their cylinders run out
they groan, unable to breathe;
even the air has turned black

Rain
vanishes
before it can touch the soil

Drinking water imported
in containers
from other planets

The political stages
remain just as they were

Communism
and capitalism
quietly
fill the pockets
of the democrats

The latest news:
a caste clash
on Mars

Even the tears we shed
have dried up
